questions.question: Moses told Israel that curses would come because, in all their abundance, they did not do what?

answers.text: Serve the LORD with joy and gladness
Share their riches with the poor
Build a great temple for the LORD

questions.question: Moses said Israel would understand the language of the far-off nation the LORD would bring against them. True or false?
Moses warned that disobedient Israel would be uprooted from its land. Where would the LORD send them?
Moses warned that Israel would be sent back to Egypt and offer themselves for sale as slaves. What would happen?

answers.text: Their enemies would buy them all
